scope_limits: No clips; exact cute-mystery preset; >=70% illustration slots; <=3 consecutive information cards.
Only source-row cast entries fund setting-sheet candidates; generic background figures do not create extra cast.
Thumbnail uses existing accepted keyframes; one selected optional music track with up to two modeled takes, existing 5s intro/21s outro.

Published rates are pre-tax list equivalents. Any attributable surcharge or tax must also fit the approved cap; an unpriced route/fee stops before dispatch. Existing subscription/server overhead is not allocated per film.
Normal retake allowance is a finite planning model, not authorization for every tool maximum retry.
A29 legacy body_estimate_seconds means the after-hook subset; this quote consistently uses narration_estimate_seconds as the complete six-chapter body.
All times are estimates; none is measured TTS, rendered runtime or passed 480-second runtime gate.
